adblock._about: Extra YouTube ad blocking, read at each app launch. block/hide/prune_keys are refreshed daily by .github/workflows/adblock.yml; put your own entries in manual_block / manual_hide / manual_prune_keys. ad_classes, skip_selectors, extra_js and prune_enabled are manual.
